name: a911-harness
description: Personal review harness for the Axon 911 frontend ecosystem: computed blast-radius tiers, contract-driven critics, and runtime verification gates across axon911-frontend, prepared911, and vault-core-ux.

axon911_root.title: axon911-frontend path
axon911_root.description: Absolute path to the axon911-frontend checkout. Owns @prepared/ui-* post CORE-754 and is the architectural authority.

prepared911_root.title: prepared911 path
prepared911_root.description: Absolute path to the prepared911 checkout. Consumes the published @prepared911/ui-* artifacts.

vault_root.title: vault-core-ux path
vault_root.description: Absolute path to the vault-core-ux knowledge repository.

attest_rewrite.title: Transparently wrap verification commands
attest_rewrite.description: Route recognized verification commands through the attesting wrapper so a forgotten wrapper cannot produce an unrecorded PASS. Disable if it conflicts with another PreToolUse Bash rewriter.
